basicInfo.description: The centralized counseling body for admissions to IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs.

eligibility.jeeMain: Required for NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs. Must secure a valid rank.
eligibility.boardPercentage: Must have 75% aggregate in 12th class (65% for SC/ST/PwD) OR be in the top 20 percentile of the respective board.
eligibility.attempts: Consecutive 3 years for JEE Main, 2 years for JEE Advanced.

process: Step 1: Registration using JEE Main application number and password.
Step 2: Choice filling - select branches and institutes in order of preference. You can fill unlimited choices.
Step 3: Mock Allotment 1 & 2 to gauge potential seats based on current trends.
Step 4: Choice locking before the strict deadline.
Step 6: Online reporting - pay seat acceptance fee and upload documents.
Step 7: Choose Freeze (keep seat), Float (upgrade anywhere), or Slide (upgrade within same institute).
documents: Category Certificate (OBC-NCL/GEN-EWS/SC/ST) strictly in central Govt format issued after April 1, 2026

fees.refundPolicy: Refundable with a processing deduction if seat is surrendered before the final round.

seatMatrix.reservation: GEN-EWS: 10%, OBC-NCL: 27%, SC: 15%, ST: 7.5%, PwD: 5% horizontal
seatMatrix.gender: 20% Supernumerary seats reserved exclusively for female candidates

commonMistakes: Filling very few choices (fill maximum choices to stay safe).
Uploading expired or wrong-format category certificates.
Missing the choice-locking deadline.
Not paying the seat acceptance fee on time, leading to cancellation.
studentTips: Always prioritize branches you actually want to study over college tags.
Use 'Float' if you are getting a lower preference but want a better one in the next round.
Check previous year closing ranks on the official JoSAA archive.

basicInfo.description: Conducts two Special Rounds to fill vacant seats in NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs after JoSAA rounds end.

csab.process: Fresh registration required. Candidates must pay a participation fee. Only unfilled seats of NIT+ system are available (IITs do NOT participate).

counselingBody.name: State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra

process: Display of Provisional and Final Merit List

Confusing 'Home University' and 'Other Than Home University' seats

Keep TFWS (Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme) option active if eligible.
